result.title: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
result.summary: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation. TuringPAI-VL is a 0.65B model built on HybridViT-MLQ, which combines convolutional local aggregation with Transformer-based global modeling. Multi-scale Latent Queries integrate spatial features and observation history within the same visual Transformer, providing a compact, structured interface to the language model. Training combines general vision-language data with geometric, cross-view, and temporal supervision. TuringPAI-VL supports general multimodal understanding and improves quantitative geometric perception over Qwen2-VL-2B, while providing a shared initialization for the two downstream VLA models. For autonomous driving, TuringPAI-Drive maintains all evaluated ADE/FDE metrics within 1.2\% of a full-token HybridViT baseline using the MLQ interface and achieves comparable aggregate scores in an in-house simulation evaluation. Using XPeng Native Runtime (XNRT) on a single NVIDIA Orin-X SoC, TuringPAI-Drive generates trajectories at 12\,Hz in on-vehicle operation. For robotic manipulation, TuringPAI-Embodied achieves a 96.8\% average success rate across the four LIBERO suites. These results demonstrate a shared vision-language foundation for driving and robotic manipulation under practical on-device constraints.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向端侧物理AI的0.65B视觉语言基础模型家族 TuringPAI-VL，基于 HybridViT-MLQ 与多尺度 latent query 将空间特征和历史观测压缩后送入语言模型，并以此共享初始化迁移到自动驾驶与机器人操作两个下游模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 多尺度 latent query 作为紧凑视觉—语言接口压缩空间与时间观测，可能可供核查视觉细节保留与信息坍缩之间的权衡，但论文重点是端侧效率与下游控制而非 latent 推理，联系需进一步确认。
